kind: Real isolated Chromium: desktop workflow plus separate mobile touch follow-up

checks.name: Desktop dashboard renders live synthetic preview and database counts
Inventory pagination shows exact server count and reaches second page
Changing a category resets pagination and filters the complete database
A camera observation appears pending and its open detail updates after a delayed AI result
Late AI cannot overwrite a dirty form; revision conflict preserves the draft
Explicit reread then a normal edit saves through the real PATCH endpoint
Expiry editing reaches due state and the real scheduler checks notification delivery
Dispose, restore, extend, recover and restore work through visible buttons
Dismissed evidence is read-only; restoration requires explicit confirmation
Privacy settings immediately stop visible MJPEG connections
Privacy exit reconnects preview; rebaseline request is distinct from completion
Browser network interruption recovers server status and preview automatically
390px mobile inventory renders without horizontal document overflow
Touch opens mobile item detail; dialog fits the viewport
Mobile editing and touch-submit save through the real API
Bottom navigation responds to touch and activates the matching camera stream

desktop_raw_result_note: The desktop checks passed; the subsequent mobile section stopped on the overflow reproduced in the separate mobile report. The final mobile follow-up passed after the CSS fix.

regressions_fixed.problem: Saved detail enabled before mutation lock released; immediate next save ignored
regressions_fixed.resolution: Release mutation once before rendering; predecessor finally cannot unlock successor; isolate late edit conflicts by open item ID

regressions_fixed.problem: Absolute screen-reader filter label escaped horizontal scroller and expanded mobile layout viewport to 423px
regressions_fixed.resolution: Position filter labels relatively; verified innerWidth/clientWidth/scrollWidth/visualViewport all390 and dialog within390x844

limits: Synthetic camera frames, delayed fake VLM and fake SMTP transport; real FastAPI routes and disposable SQLite. No production data, live camera, remote model, or external email was used.
